progression.title: Establish food and fire
progression.summary: Gather grass with a hoe, make Kindling, light a campfire, and cook food to reveal ingredient effects.

progression.title: Build the Mud Kiln
progression.summary: Use dried grass and earthen materials to construct the first processing station.

progression.title: Advance through metals
progression.summary: Build a Blast Furnace, obtain iron and gold, then create Carbon-Rich Iron and Steel.

progression.title: Unlock smithing and alloys
progression.summary: Use the Smithing Table for equipment upgrades and progress through Hepatizon, Shakudo, Electrum, and Adamant.

progression.title: Build a community
progression.summary: Acquire Obols, recruit an asylum seeker, trade fish, and work with the redesigned professions.

progression.title: Enter the Nether
progression.summary: Synthesize Benzene, stabilize Estus, craft a Hell-Bound Book, and begin crafting Blessings.

progression.title: Complete the End path
progression.summary: Locate the stronghold, defeat the Ender Dragon, obtain Elytra, and apply the late-game wing upgrades.

differences.title: Natural health regeneration is disabled
differences.summary: Food and other custom recovery systems replace vanilla natural regeneration.

differences.title: Inventory is kept after death
differences.summary: The keep_inventory gamerule is enabled, while the custom heart system removes two maximum-health points after each recorded death.

differences.title: Maximum health can change
differences.summary: Crystal Hearts add two health points up to 60. Death removes two points, with the configured lower bound set to 20.

differences.title: Vanilla time advancement is disabled
differences.summary: The pack advances time through a scheduled function at approximately one game tick per three server ticks.

differences.title: Sleeping advances time gradually
differences.summary: While a player sleeps, the pack repeatedly adds 120 ticks and clears the weather rather than using normal night skipping.

differences.title: Phantom spawning is disabled
differences.summary: The spawn_phantoms gamerule is set to false.

differences.title: Hostile mobs scale differently by difficulty
differences.summary: Skeleton, creeper, cave-spider, zombie, husk, silverfish, and spider attributes or equipment are modified by difficulty.

differences.title: Equipment can be repaired indefinitely
differences.summary: The pack resets the repair-cost component on inventory and hotbar items.

differences.title: Equipment progression uses custom alloys
differences.summary: Advancements guide players through copper, iron, Carbon-Rich Iron, Steel, Hepatizon, Shakudo, Electrum, and Adamant equipment.

differences.title: Blessings group related enchantments
differences.summary: Craftable prayer and elegy books contain predefined combinations of enchantments.

differences.title: Explosion drops do not decay
differences.summary: Block and mob explosions retain all eligible drops.

differences.title: Overworld and Nether dimension settings are replaced
differences.summary: The pack supplies custom dimension-type definitions, including altered darkness behavior.
